text:
Maya: Quick async check — need owners and blockers for onboarding Kelp-9b and MarinerLite into the model-catalog. Legal signoff, perf profiles, and canary infra are the gating items. EOD Friday cutoff. Who's owning each?
Sam: I'm on legal for Kelp-9b. Waiting on CLA from upstream author, pinged them this morning. If no back-and-forth, ETA Thu 4pm.
Kevin: Perf has baseline numbers for Kelp9b: p50 ~120ms, p95 ~340ms with q4f32 on A10G. Long-tail (>2k seq) stability flakey — need overnight run. Can start if infra frees up.
Liz: Curation: manifests + metadata done for both. MarinerLite embeddings shape check failing (dim mismatch). Putting a note in the manifest and assigning to @Juan to reconcile shapes. Also uploaded initial prompt set for eval.
Juan: Infra — reserved small burst pool (tag: canary-kelp9b) but there's a scheduled internal job at 03:00 that uses the same reservation. I can shift that job if you confirm by EOB today.
Sam: Legal note re: MarinerLite: found a non-commercial clause in para 4.2. Product/legal needs to confirm whether we can host. @Maya can you confirm intended use (hosted vs private-only)? If private-only, still want perf artifacts.
Maya: I'll review para 4.2 and loop in product counsel. If it's private-only we proceed with Private docs + perf. Flagging as potential go/no-go for hosted.
Kevin: Quick command I'll run for the long-tail sweep (if pool available):
```
python tests/run_latency_sweep.py --model kelp9b --seq-lens 512,1024,2048 --repeats 500
export REDWOOD_POOL=canary-kelp9b
```
Liz: QA/canary checklist for clarity: 1) legal cleared, 2) perf long-tail green, 3) infra reserved, 4) smoke tests pass. I'll tick items as they complete and post a final canary-go note.
Maya: Action items: Sam -> legal triage (Kelp + Mariner), Kevin -> perf long-tail (start tonight if infra ok), Juan -> confirm pool & shift job, Liz -> fix embeddings shape + smoke. Agree? :thumbsup:
Kevin: :thumbsup: starting in 15m.
Juan: Confirmed — shifted the internal job, pool is free. Will post reservation id in #infra-provision once live.
Liz: Noted. I'll re-run shape conversion and then kick off evals.
Sam: I'll update legal thread with current product intent and ETA.
Maya: Thanks all — I'll follow up on para 4.2 and post final hosted/private decision. Ping here if anything blocks the night run.
